description: This Java source file defines the PatientIdentifierTypeValidator class, which implements the Spring Validator interface to validate PatientIdentifierType objects within the OpenMRS medical record system. The validator ensures proper field lengths, non-empty required fields, and checks for duplicate names among non-retired identifier types.
